escalation.deviationRule: any deviation from the approved plan on alwaysHuman-class work returns to the human before it lands in a commit or draft PR — never silently

stationConduct.pollForeground: never stop the turn to wait on long-running commands (CI, test suites, builds): poll in the foreground with bounded sleeps/checks until the result arrives or the timeout escalates
stationConduct.contextStewardship: route long outputs to files and reference paths; a pass approaching heavy context finishes its current unit, writes the handoff, and exits for a fresh wake — station passes never depend on compaction
stationConduct.reFetchDontSummarize: file reads are re-fetchable — never carry a summarized file forward as if it were the file; re-read on demand (compaction loses specifics: measured 0/3 survival)
stationConduct.toolFriction: when a tool fights you (wrong result shape, extra round-trips, workaround needed), append a one-line friction note to your station_passes row — weakness mining clusters these into runbook/config proposals
stationConduct.captureDiscoveries: a non-obvious operational discovery (deploy topology, service quirk, decoy config, env behavior) must be captured as a runbook (/marsh:capture) before the session ends — chat and throwaway scripts are not storage
stationConduct.flakeRule: a test failing intermittently across 2 reruns is a flake candidate: file/annotate an issue with the evidence; excluding it from the gate requires human approval, never a silent skip
